title: Verify: Phaser dependency pin unit tests
summary: Unit tests read manifest and lockfile
description: Add a test mirroring zustandDependency.test.ts that reads package.json and package-lock.json from disk.

steps.action: Create a vitest file modelled on tests/zustandDependency.test.ts with test 'declares phaser as ~3.90.0' asserting package.json dependencies.phaser === '~3.90.0', and test 'locks phaser to 3.90.x' asserting package-lock.json packages['node_modules/phaser'].version matches /^3\.90\./ and packages[''].dependencies.phaser === '~3.90.0'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserDependency.test.ts
